question: Does the seated coat exemption (entry 19) also cover the lie-back, i.e. from the start of the lie-back (frame 56) until the lying support is established (frame 63)?
context: Entry 19 recorded the coordinator reading 'the window ends where the lie-back starts'. During the 7-frame lie-back the coat goes from hanging (seated) to flat under the body (b20 lying corrective, fully on at 63).

evidence.coat_hanging_through_the_lie_back: a06-prep/clearance-draft5-lying63.json: no sword crossing anywhere; the only remaining problem is the coat 28-272 mm below the bed top at 57-62
evidence.coat_lifted_by_forward_swing: a06-prep/settle-draft8-forward.json: the coat tails need about 87 deg of forward swing right after 56 (tabard about 45); drafts 6-10 (clearance-draft6..10.json) then pass the bed everywhere but the swinging coat crosses the socketed sword's grip by 2.5-9 mm (left half-skirt side, tabard, right half-skirt), which no clip-level tuck or timing removed (cross-list-draft9.json)

options.title: Extend the seated window to the lie-back
options.what: seated_on_bed for LieDown becomes [2, 62]; the coat hangs (as in draft5) and slides under the body until the b20 lying corrective takes over at 63; GetUp mirrors it (from leaving the lying support until standing).
options.needs: your confirmation (a wider exemption than the recorded reading)

options.title: Move the bed socket away from the hip
options.what: Re-place the sword further toward the foot end (new socket, re-registered LieDown/Sleep configs, Sleep re-check, a new put-down reach study); uncertain whether the arm still reaches.

encoding: corrected to [2, 63] (registry 7552821be8d3, 2026-10-06): the a06 check found the coat 29.8/19.3/8.7 mm below the bed top at 62.25/62.5/62.75, quarter frames between the two windows inside the approved lie-back; scripts/cv1_interaction.py now lets a seated window meet a bed-support window on that one shared frame and ends the exemption where the support covers t, so the exemption runs to the support establishment and frame 63 itself is measured
GetUp seated_on_bed [27, 87] (registry 3f3eb4faba32): from leave_bed, where the support window ends, until standing (mirror of LieDown 2..63)
resolution.unchanged: weapon_body 1 mm (the coat must not cross the sword: solved in LieDown a07 with a 19 deg body-right coat swing, no exemption); bed clearance of every other mesh
